fal-text-to-image 0.1.0 – Initial Release

- Generate, remix, and edit images with fal.ai's advanced AI models, including FLUX, Recraft, Imagen, and more.
- Supports text-to-image creation, image remixing, and targeted inpainting/masked editing.
- Intelligent automatic model selection based on task and prompt context.
- Command-line interface with flexible options for model, size, style reference, and more.
- High-resolution (up to 2K), style transfer, typography, and commercial-safe image generation supported.
- Troubleshooting tips, authentication setup, and usage examples included.
